authority.user_instruction: Build and validate the hardened real local Compose topology one bounded surface at a time while the host CLI exclusively owns Docker and every executable source remains gated and exact-digest pinned.

scope.objective: Acquire and inspect the already source-gated exact images, freeze a closed Compose contract, then implement and real-surface validate a host-controlled, network-denied PostgreSQL/Python/Node topology without weakening the manifest authority boundary.
forbidden_work: Mounting a Docker or container-engine socket into any container
Giving containers secrets, privileged mode, host network, broad host mounts, or external runtime network
Executing an image before its exact artifact, SBOM, provenance, vulnerability and license evidence pass the applicable gate
Allowing repository content or an agent-facing command to approve or replace the workflow digest
Using floating image tags, unpinned build frontends, unpinned package dependencies, or online dependency resolution during a controlled build
Starting dashboard, recovery, publication, cloud, Kubernetes, multi-tenancy, or arbitrary remote execution work
Claiming a test or Compose config render proves a real service surface
reversible_actions: Acquire exact source-gated image digests into local Docker custody without running them
Inspect registry and local image metadata, SBOM, provenance, licenses and vulnerability scans
Create exact-pinned Dockerfiles, locks, Compose configuration, migrations, runner fixtures, host CLI code, tests and documentation
Start and stop the approved local topology only after acquisition and scan gates pass
Use narrow project-owned staging, volume and temporary evidence custody
Commit and push verified bounded improvements
stop_conditions: An image or dependency cannot pass source, integrity, license or critical vulnerability gates
The topology cannot preserve host-only Docker ownership or default-deny runtime egress
A required change alters the product promise, trust boundary, approval authority, or explicit security gate
A test would require a real secret, sensitive data, paid service, ownership change, irreversible action, or unsupported release claim
The checkpoint cannot be verified from clean local and public custody

units.purpose: Acquire the four already source-gated exact image artifacts without running them; bind platform child digests; retain registry and local identity, SBOM, provenance, license and vulnerability evidence; decide whether runtime inspection may proceed.
retained_failures: Docker Scout CLI 1.24.0 matched its GitHub release digest and published checksum, but its extracted executable was not Authenticode-signed. Source Gate 003 blocked execution, and the unexecuted temporary custody was removed.
The initial Docker Official PostgreSQL, Node and Python candidates failed the applicable critical-vulnerability gate and were superseded without execution.
Cosign's Authenticode-only bootstrap path was inconclusive because the executable was NotSigned; the separately source-gated Sigstore TUF artifact-key path passed before Cosign executed.
The exact-image evaluation preserves failed and invalid evidence attempts separately from the final passing disposition.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: Four exact linux/amd64 images are digest-locked with local identity, source, signature or provenance, SBOM, vulnerability, license and conditional execution dispositions; no container was started.

units.purpose: Freeze the Compose, service identity, network, mount, user, filesystem, health, migration, runner and host-orchestration contracts before implementation.
outputs: ADR for host orchestration and staged custody
retained_failures: Two malformed read-only policy-status invocations returned stable usage exit 64 and remain distinct INVALID attempts. The correct invocation returned the expected MISSING approval state and INVALID verification verdict at exit 12.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: The exact-image-bound topology contract, normalized render contract, staged-custody model, host-only authority, evidence separation, and twelve fail-closed security mutations passed without starting Docker runtime surfaces.

units.purpose: Implement exact-pinned Dockerfiles, offline dependency locks, Compose configuration, migrations, service probes and host-CLI orchestration without starting the topology.
retained_failures: The initial full Compose model digest included generated temporary paths and was not stable. The final redacted model digest repeated exactly.
The first mutation-harness copy omitted one locked fixture and failed with IS_TOPOLOGY_READ; the corrected bounded copy passed baseline and all thirteen mutations.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: The real host CLI rendered the exact locked Compose implementation, matched the frozen security projection, passed runner source probes and thirteen implementation mutations, and changed no Docker resource history.

units.purpose: Start the exact local topology through the real host CLI and probe container identity, users, capabilities, filesystems, mounts, networks, egress denial, health and Docker-socket absence.
retained_failures: Two revision-1 host-CLI runtime attempts returned IS_RUNTIME_HEALTH. The second captured confirmed PostgreSQL PGDATA permission denial under required user 70:70. Three superseded derived image IDs and the failed volume remain retained; containers and network were removed.

The first revision-2 static attempt found a generated Python __pycache__ byte in the exact build context and returned IS_TOPOLOGY_IMPLEMENTATION before any build. The byte was moved intact to recoverable non-OneDrive temp custody before replay.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: Topology revision 2 preserved the non-root boundary, built and bound four exact local image IDs, passed database health and all identity, privilege, filesystem, mount, network, egress and Docker-endpoint probes twice, and removed containers and network after each run while retaining exact labeled volumes.

units.purpose: Validate one-shot migrations, PostgreSQL identity, health, least privilege, schema, persistence and restart behavior through the real topology.
retained_failures: The first real database probe completed with verdict FAIL and exit 10: migration, PostgreSQL identity, schema, bounded DML, persistence, restart and teardown passed, but both application runners use the bootstrap superuser and their forbidden CREATE TABLE probe succeeded. The probe removed that table and all runtime resources except the exact retained volume.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: Revision 3 separated bootstrap and application roles, passed exact topology gates, real idempotent migration, PostgreSQL identity, schema, migration record, bounded runner DML, denied runner DDL and migration-ledger reads, restart persistence, repeatability and teardown.

units.purpose: Validate the real Python runner against approved staged input and PostgreSQL, with no secrets, egress, Docker control or writable source mounts.
retained_failures: The first real Python probe returned a valid product FAIL at exit 10. The application container exited zero and its exact result, PostgreSQL row, invalid-input rejection, isolation, and teardown passed, but Docker Compose transport stderr was incorrectly treated as application failure. Quiet progress preserved that FAIL because an inspected completed migration container remained until final teardown and Compose correctly emitted an orphan warning. Both exact invocations and their pre-remediation locks remain retained.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: Two exact host-CLI runs executed the shipped Python application command, matched independently computed output and PostgreSQL evidence, rejected malformed input without output or row, preserved the runtime boundary, and removed all containers and network while retaining the bound database volume.

units.purpose: Validate the real Node runner against the same approved staged contract and isolation controls.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: Two exact host-CLI runs executed the shipped Node application command, matched independently computed output and PostgreSQL evidence, agreed with retained Python evidence on the canonical input digest, rejected malformed input without output or row, preserved the runtime boundary, and removed all containers and network while retaining the bound database volume.

units.purpose: Run repeated clean-start, failure, cancellation, restart and teardown scenarios and verify the entire topology from a clean clone without orphaned resources or broadened trust.
retained_failures: Two clean-clone harness attempts remain INVALID: one combined command was rejected before execution by local command policy, and one split attempt treated normal unittest stderr as a terminating PowerShell error before any real reliability command ran. The corrected split harness passed.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: Two canonical runs and one exact credential-free public-clone run passed fresh bootstrap, exact runners and rows, distinct PASS/FAIL/INVALID/failed/cancelled states, recovery, restart persistence, orphan detection, protected-volume custody, repeatability, and disposable teardown.

units.purpose: Commit, push, fresh-clone, tag and independently verify the bounded IS-0003 checkpoint without claiming dashboard, recovery or release completion.
retained_failures: The first remote tag-absence invocation was INVALID because PowerShell parsed unquoted peeled-tag braces; the quoted credential-free retry proved absence before marker creation.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: Exact closure commit a0c05070 and tree 67c05a10 passed the complete credential-free clone matrix and real reliability surface; annotated tag object 28eea260 independently peeled to that exact public commit.

required_checks: Exact image source-gate revalidation and platform binding
SBOM, provenance, license and vulnerability disposition before execution
Compose render and fail-closed mutation checks
Real container identity, privilege, capability, filesystem, mount, network and egress probes
Real PostgreSQL migration, health, persistence and restart checks
Real Python and Node runner positive and negative paths
Repeated startup, failure, cancellation, cleanup and clean-clone validation
Git diff, secret scan and post-push branch and tag verification
completed_checks: Exact image source-gate revalidation and platform binding
SBOM, provenance, license and vulnerability disposition before execution
Closed topology contract and fail-closed mutation checks
Compose render and fail-closed mutation checks
Real container identity, privilege, capability, filesystem, mount, network and egress probes
Real PostgreSQL migration, health, persistence and restart checks
Real Python runner positive, negative, database, isolation, repeatability and teardown checks
Real Node runner positive, negative, cross-runner, database, isolation, repeatability and teardown checks
Repeated canonical and credential-free clean-clone reliability, failure, invalidity, cancellation, recovery, restart, orphan and teardown checks

handoff.current_checkpoint: IS-0003 complete at verified public commit a0c05070dd1d147aecae6b4ed686440414a3aa27 and annotated marker checkpoint-is-0003 tag object 28eea260147265e7dd0328dcd072e134586a2ff0
handoff.next_action: Begin a new IS-0004 evidence-and-recovery milestone from checkpoint-is-0003, preserving the exact machine CLI and Docker trust boundary while adding append-only receipts, idempotency, cancellation records, crash recovery, verified database backup/restore, and an independent offline receipt verifier one bounded unit at a time.
do_not_carry_forward: Do not run an image merely because acquisition or metadata passed
Do not mount Docker authority into containers
Do not add secrets, external runtime network, broad mounts or privileged execution
Do not let repository content approve its own workflow manifest
Do not collapse verification verdicts into lifecycle state
